# Flux QC 

**Logic table:**

Situation,                              CO2,  CH4,  N2O
CO2 p > 0.05 or CO2 flux > 9*,           NA,   NA,   NA
"CO2 is good, but CH4/N2O p > 0.05",    keep, 0,    0
CO2 is good and CH4/N2O p ≤ 0.05,       keep, keep, keep

*Set very high woodland CO2 emissions (> 9) related to ant burrow to `NA`

```{r flux-qc}
data <- data %>%
  group_by(date, cover, site, transect, rep) %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract the CO2 values for this chamber measurement
    co2_p     = p.value[gas == "co2"][1],
    co2_flux  = flux[gas == "co2"][1],
    
    # Flag bad analytical process / injection based on CO2
    bad_injection = (is.na(co2_p) | co2_p > 0.05) | 
                    (!is.na(co2_flux) & co2_flux > 9)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    flux = case_when(
      # Everything from a bad injection becomes NA
      bad_injection ~ NA_real_,
      
      # CO2 that passed the checks keeps its value
      gas == "co2" ~ flux,
      
      # CH4 / N2O with non-significant slope → 0 (only if injection was good)
      gas %in% c("ch4", "n2o") & p.value > 0.05 ~ 0,
      
      # Otherwise keep the calculated flux
      TRUE ~ flux
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-co2_p, -co2_flux, -bad_injection) %>%
  ungroup()
```
